Gymnastikos Syllogos Marko Markopoulou is a Greek football club based in Markopoulo Mesogeas. Its official founding year is 1927. Its official colors are green and white. Its emblem is a vine leaf. It uses the Municipal Stadium of Markopoulo Mesogeas as its home ground.
